body:
A self-driving company needs agents that can investigate issues, prepare reports and build with company data. When that data sits on a private network, teams shouldn’t have to choose between keeping it secure and putting it to work.

Replit’s enterprise controls include governance tools , separate development and production databases , and single-tenant infrastructure. Bring Your Own Cloud adds options for running Replit in your own cloud.

## Introducing Tunnels

A tunnel connects Replit environments to services residing in your private network, such as databases and internal APIs, by transiting through a client that IT runs inside your network. Tunnels are fully integrated with Replit’s connectors, making it easier for Replit to reach your company’s services in a secure manner.

Private services stay private. IT chooses which services each Replit workspace can reach, without opening the whole network or allowing public inbound access. Service authentication and permissions control what Replit can read or change.

Tunnel traffic is encrypted. mTLS encrypts and authenticates the tunnel between the Tunnels client and Replit. IT configures each private service’s authentication and TLS separately.

You may contact our team to learn more and ask about Tunnels early access. Once enabled, go to your Workspace Settings to create a new tunnel, and add endpoints. All traffic to these endpoints flows through Replit’s tunnel server and the Tunnels client in your private network. This includes authentication requests from connectors, tool calls from Agent, and request from published apps:

## What you can do with Tunnels

## Financial services: review accounts receivable

Query account records (example connectors used: Stripe, Sharepoint, and Snowflake) on your private network: “What are the accounts that need a further look?” Identify clients with outstanding balances, mismatched payments and missing documentation.

## Healthcare: find referral delays

Ask Replit: “Which patient referrals are waiting to be scheduled?” Query records (example connectors used Calendly and DrChrono) on your private network to find delays and incomplete handoffs for your care operations team to follow up on.

## Manufacturing: identify material shortages

Build a material tracking dashboard using stock and production records (example connectors used: NetSuite, Shopify, Databricks, and Shippo) on your private network. Compare available and required quantities by part number and SKU to flag shortages and orders at risk of delay.

These are just a few examples of how Tunnels and Replit Connectors give enterprise teams secure access to private data and services, bringing the self-driving company vision closer to reality.

## Get early access to Tunnels

Contact our team to learn more and ask about Tunnels early access.
ar_body:
أعلنت Replit ميزة Tunnels التي تتيح للوكلاء والتطبيقات الوصول إلى بيانات الشركة الموجودة في شبكة خاصة، مع الحفاظ على أمانها.

• يعمل النفق عبر عميل تشغّله إدارة تقنية المعلومات داخل شبكة الشركة.
• تبقى الخدمات الخاصة خاصة، وتحدد الإدارة ما يمكن لكل مساحة عمل الوصول إليه دون فتح الشبكة بالكامل.
• تُشفَّر الحركة وتُوثَّق بين العميل وReplit عبر mTLS.
• تتكامل مع موصلات Replit، وتمر عبره طلبات المصادقة واستدعاءات الأدوات وطلبات التطبيقات المنشورة.
• أمثلة الاستخدام: مراجعة الحسابات المستحقة في القطاع المالي، ورصد تأخر الإحالات في الرعاية الصحية، وتتبع نقص المواد في التصنيع.
• الميزة متاحة بالوصول المبكر عبر التواصل مع فريق Replit.

تفيد الميزة الشركات التي تريد الاستفادة من بياناتها الخاصة مع الالتزام بمتطلبات الأمان.
